4Read the facts. Write a comparative sentence using the word in brackets.

    The scarf is 90 TL. The hat is 150 TL. (cheap)

    Ada is 10 years old. Kuzey is 12 years old. (old)

  3. 3

    My suitcase is 8 kg. Your suitcase is 5 kg. (heavy)

    The blue ribbon is 30 cm. The red ribbon is 50 cm. (long)

    My room is 20°C. Your room is 25°C. (warm)
